name: Woodbury Centre
summary: Woodbury Centre is a thriving 228,008 square foot community shopping center anchored by Kohl's and featuring popular national retailers including Ulta Beauty, ALDI, Michaels, and numerous fashion outlet tenants. The center offers convenient one-stop shopping with recent additions of high-traffic retailers, complemented by restaurant outparcels and an adjacent Hampton Inn hotel.
demographics: Woodbury Centre serves a suburban family-oriented market in Orange County, New York, with a trade area characterized by middle to upper-middle income households. The center attracts a diverse demographic mix including young families, working professionals, and retirees who value convenient access to national retailers and everyday shopping needs. Primary visitors are typically aged 25-65 with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000, seeking value-oriented shopping combined with quality brands. The location benefits from both local residential traffic and visitors to the adjacent Hampton Inn hotel, creating a steady flow of shoppers throughout the week.
description: Woodbury Centre is a well-established community shopping destination in Woodbury, New York, offering 228,008 square feet of retail space that serves the diverse needs of Orange County residents and visitors. The center features an impressive lineup of national retailers anchored by Kohl's department store, complemented by popular specialty retailers including Michaels, Ulta Beauty, Chico's, Talbots, Eileen Fisher, and Scrubs & Beyond. The property has experienced significant momentum with recent additions of highly-trafficked tenants such as Ulta Beauty, ALDI grocery store, Harbor Freight Tools, and Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, demonstrating the center's ongoing evolution and commitment to meeting contemporary shopping preferences. Beyond its core retail offerings, Woodbury Centre provides a comprehensive shopping experience with numerous fashion and housewares outlet tenants, creating an attractive value proposition for budget-conscious shoppers. The center's appeal is further enhanced by three owned restaurant outparcels and an adjacent Hampton Inn hotel, making it a convenient destination for both local residents and travelers seeking quality shopping, dining, and lodging options in one accessible location.
